definitions.sampleSelection: REXCESS: 31 nearby clusters selected from REFLEX by X-ray luminosity only ("selected by luminosity only, in such a way as to have close to homogeneous coverage of luminosity space"), 0.0564 <= z <= 0.1832; 'Pratt+09: M_Y = mass from the M500-Y_X relation of Arnaud+07'
definitions.h70: H0 = 70, so h70 = 1 and units are Msun and Mpc^2

records.notes: Verified: refitting the 31 table values (M500 from R500 and z, Y_sph(R500) / E(z)^(2/3)) with orthogonal regression gives slope 1.791 and log A = -4.739 (OLS: 1.789, -4.739), against the paper's 1.790 +/- 0.015 and -4.739 +/- 0.003.

records.run: Y_SZ D_A^2-M500, universal GNFW pressure profile, cylindrical, R500 aperture (Y_SZ D_A^2 within R500)

axes.xDefinition: log10 M500 (mass inside the radius at which the mean density is 500 times the critical density at the cluster redshift; computed from the tabulated R500 and z; R500 iterated from the M500-Y_X relation)
axes.yDefinition: log10 Y_SZ D_A^2, cylindrical, R500 aperture (Y_SZ D_A^2 within R500); the published h(z)^(-2/3) scaling is re-applied at the epoch, so this is the physical value

selection.warning: Model relation built by the authors from the universal GNFW pressure profile (REXCESS data plus simulations at large radii) with the mass scaling slope fixed to 1.78 from the M500-Y_X relation; extent R_b = 5 R500 assumed for the cylindrical integral. The paper estimates an uncertainty of +/-0.06 on the slope and +/-0.024 dex on the normalisation. Not a direct measurement of Y_SZ.
